description: React component for managing a list of GPS devices, allowing users to add or remove devices dynamically.

methods.name: DeviceManager
methods.description: Main React functional component handling device list state, rendering UI for device management.

methods.name: handleAdd
methods.description: Adds a new device to the device list using the current input value.

methods.name: handleRemove
methods.description: Removes a device from the list given its ID.
